name: Hugeicons — All Icons
summary: Browsable library of 60,000+ icons in 10 styles and 59 categories, with free and pro tiers.
description: The Hugeicons icon browser: 60,000+ icons in 10 styles — Rounded (Bulk, Solid, Twotone, Duotone, Stroke, Free), Standard (Duotone, Solid, Stroke) and Sharp (Solid, Stroke) — organised into 59 categories such as AI, Arrows, Business, Editing, E-Commerce and Dashboard. Icons are searched and filtered by style and category, then downloaded or installed through packages for React, Vue, Angular and Svelte, an icon font or the Figma library.
contains: styles: Rounded (Bulk, Solid, Twotone, Duotone, Stroke, Free), Standard (Duotone, Solid, Stroke), Sharp (Solid, Stroke)
per-category usage counts next to each of the 59 categories
free tier: 6,000+ Stroke Rounded icons, web app and dev formats; pro tiers: Pro and Pro Plus
